summary: EXAMPLES-005: The executable-driver examples model abrupt child-process cleanup with `SIGKILL` and `exit()` from the client detach callback, and they do not handle `execl()` failure in the child. `client.c` also leaves the adapter attached/released only by process exit. As examples, these teach fragile lifecycle handling. Prefer graceful detach/release/stop flow, report child exec failure, close unused pipe ends in both processes, and terminate the child only from normal shutdown code. Fixed: Use normal shutdown ownership, uni handles and parser join; handle pipe/fork/exec errors, close descriptors and reap exact child with bounded graceful termination.
